description: This file defines the RAGFlowConfig class, which extends OpenAIConfig to enable interaction with RAGFlow's OpenAI-compatible API. It handles parsing model names, constructing API URLs, environment validation, and request transformation specific to RAGFlow's model naming conventions and API structure.

classes.name: RAGFlowConfig
classes.description: Class providing configuration for RAGFlow's OpenAI-compatible API, including URL construction, environment validation, and request transformation tailored to RAGFlow's model naming conventions and API structure.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
